verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly documents 'Auto top-up from linked checking accounts with target balance automation and low balance alerts' (ramp-docs-6) and its Treasury product offers checking/investment account automation with yield (ramp-docs-29, ramp-supp-checking-account). However, evidence doesn't detail how the low-balance alert mechanism works (channels, thresholds, configurability) beyond the one-line claim, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of the auto top-up feature actually functioning. Missing for 10: detailed documentation or hands-on evidence of alert configuration UI/workflow, and third-party verification that auto top-up reliably triggers as described.
